problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 37 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 50 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 67 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 34 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 35 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 53 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 43 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 46 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 58 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 61 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 60 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 63 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 35 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 35 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 50 cubic feet
* Package 22: size 58 cubic feet
* Package 23: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 24: size 55 cubic feet
* Package 25: size 64 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
